answer: Bind each agent to a hardware attestation key sealed in a TPM or secure enclave, like a quartz crystal cut once and never cloned. The registry accepts one identity per attested chip, so a sybil farm must buy real devices, roughly 30 dollars each, instead of spinning up free keys. Reused chips get flagged and slashed. Like a zephyr crossing a walled garden, honest agents pass freely while mass fakes hit a physical cost wall.
